tool.name: check_office_availability
tool.description: Finds out whether the office can see the caller. Use only for an office visit, and only once the caller has named a day (such as Monday, tomorrow or the sixteenth). A week alone (next week) or no time at all is not a day: do not call it then; ask what day and time works best for them, and call it after they answer. If they named a day and time, send starts_at. If they named only a day or a part of the day, send window_start and window_end for what they said. Say nothing while it runs; the phone system says the waiting line. Then say only what it answered, using each spoken value: available: that time is open; if it is the time they asked for, ask their name if you do not have it, then call book_office_visit with that starts_at, and ask for their email only after the booking answered. options: offer the times in alternatives and let them pick one; then ask their name if you do not have it, and call book_office_visit with the starts_at they picked. unavailable: that time is not open; offer the times in alternatives, or ask for another day if there are none; once they pick one, ask their name if you do not have it, then call book_office_visit with its starts_at. unknown: you cannot confirm right now and the office will confirm with them; take the time as a message, ask their name if you do not have it, and do not call again. Never say a visit is booked from this tool.

parameters.name: starts_at
parameters.description: The exact time the caller named, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Leave out if they named no exact time.

parameters.name: window_start
parameters.description: The start of the time the caller described, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Morning starts at 09:00, afternoon at 12:00. Leave out when you send starts_at.

parameters.name: window_end
parameters.description: The end of the time the caller described, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Morning ends at 12:00, afternoon and a whole day at 17:00. Leave out when you send starts_at.
